dialogues.speaker: Phonia
dialogues.text: Greetings, Honorary Knight. The game board has been reset. You may begin your simulations at any time.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Rather well. Thanks to you, we've already come up with standard combat procedures for most common monsters.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: If you're interested, you'll be able to find these procedures in our library once we're done putting them together.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: But with your immense strength, I doubt you would need these strategies, designed as they are for ordinary knights. Perhaps you might even "critique," rather than "check," them.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: In any case, until our analytic assignment ends, feel free to perform simulations as you please, as many times as you please.

choices.text: About the weakness you mentioned before...

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Hmm. You speak of the contradiction between the "range advantage granted by alchemical recon gear" and "the significant reduction in current weapon effectiveness at long ranges."

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: I discussed this issue with our Outrider after the previous joint Wargames. Our final conclusion was that our most efficient way forward is to improve the weapons themselves.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Longer range, faster rates of fire, greater payload strength. As to how we can achieve that, I'm not so sure — that's Ematol's area of expertise.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Sure, she's dumb and noisy, her head has nothing in it besides explosives, she often falls behind on rent, and she can't even cook, but when it comes to weapons development, she knows her duty as a "cog."

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: So I choose to trust her judgment. No matter what she gets up to, I will... provide support, within reason.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: That said, I must confess that this idea of "digging a cone-shaped cavity inside bombs to increase their explosive power" sounds like a load of hogwash...

choices.text: Well, I'll leave you to it then. See you.

response.speaker: Phonia
response.text: Don't worry, you weren't disturbing me either way. If there is anything I can help with, or if there's any intel you need me to gather, you need only ask, Honorary Knight.
